description: Golden question set for Clause. Every expected source names a sample document and a short text it must contain. must_include lists key facts: each inner list is a group of acceptable alternatives.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do employees get?
questions.reference: Employees get 20 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

questions.question: What is the minimum notice period for permanent employees?
questions.reference: Permanent employees must give and receive at least thirty (30) days' notice in writing.

questions.question: Who has to approve a payment in lieu of notice?
questions.reference: Payment in lieu of notice needs the written approval of the HR Director.

expected_sources.contains: written approval of the HR Director

questions.question: How long is paternity leave?
questions.reference: Paternity leave is 2 weeks of fully paid leave, taken within three months of the birth or adoption.

expected_sources.contains: 2 weeks of fully paid paternity leave

questions.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
questions.reference: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with their manager's approval.

questions.question: When is a medical certificate needed for sick leave?
questions.reference: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.

questions.question: How long is the probation period in the employment contract?
questions.reference: The employment contract sets a probation period of three (3) months.

questions.question: How long must information be kept confidential after employment ends?
questions.reference: Company information must be kept confidential for two (2) years after employment ends.

questions.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the supply agreement for convenience?
questions.reference: Either party can terminate for convenience with at least sixty (60) days' written notice.

questions.question: Within how many days must supplier invoices be paid?
questions.reference: Undisputed invoices must be paid within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

questions.question: What interest is charged on late payments to the supplier?
questions.reference: Late payments carry interest of 1.5% per month on the overdue amount.

questions.question: How long do customers have to return a product?
questions.reference: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused and in the original packaging.

questions.question: Can sale items be returned?
questions.reference: Sale items are final sale and cannot be returned unless they are faulty.

questions.question: How long does a refund take?
questions.reference: Refunds reach the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the return arrives.

questions.question: What is the price of SKU-4471?
questions.reference: SKU-4471, the X200 Wireless Headphones, costs PKR 24,999.

questions.question: How much does the 65W USB-C Charger cost?
questions.reference: The 65W USB-C Charger (SKU-1108) costs PKR 3,999.

questions.question: What warranty does the X200 come with?
questions.reference: The X200 Wireless Headphones have an extended 2-year (24-month) warranty.

questions.question: What is the mileage rate for using a personal car for work?
questions.reference: Personal car use for work is reimbursed at PKR 45 per kilometre.

questions.question: What is the daily allowance for international travel?
questions.reference: The international daily allowance is USD 80 per day.

questions.question: When is business class allowed on flights?
questions.reference: Business class is allowed for flights over 6 hours, with director approval.

questions.question: How long does express delivery take and where is it available?
questions.reference: Express delivery takes 1 business day and is available only in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad.

questions.question: When is delivery free?
questions.reference: Delivery is free for orders over PKR 10,000; smaller orders pay a flat PKR 250.

questions.question: Compare the notice period in the employment contract with the notice period in the HR policy.
questions.reference: Both require 30 days: the contract says either party may end employment with thirty (30) days' written notice, and the HR policy sets a minimum of thirty (30) days for permanent employees.

questions.question: Does the contract's payment in lieu of notice rule match the HR policy?
questions.reference: Not fully: the contract lets the company pay in lieu of notice at its discretion, but the HR policy requires written approval from the HR Director.

expected_sources.contains: written approval of the HR Director

questions.question: My X200 headphones broke 10 days after delivery. Can I return them, or what happens?
questions.reference: The 7-day return window has passed, so it is handled as a warranty repair; the X200 has a 2-year warranty.

questions.question: How many of those days can be carried over if unused?
questions.reference: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over, and they must be used by 31 March.

questions.question: Can I bring my dog to the office?
questions.reference: Not in the documents.
